rationale: C04 plausibly supplied a material drafting template. Both letters begin from the rapid development and national importance of aviation, assign a specialized body an aviation-related planning task, balance military or defense considerations against civilian welfare and peacetime benefits, and instruct coordination with the aviation industry and other interested groups. The child substantially compresses and adapts that machinery from an airport-policy study to anniversary planning. C06 is close because it directs the same Air Coordinating Committee to undertake an aviation assignment, but it provides less shared language and less of the child’s government-industry coordination framework. C12 has a similar coordination model but concerns unrelated resource planning and is more generic.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The rapid progress and growth of aviation has resulted as a combination of the efforts of government and industry
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Since that time both civil and military air traffic have been growing rapidly... Meanwhile, there has been great progress in the art of flying... At the same time, the Nation's investment in both civil and military airports has undergone tremendous expansion.
shared_material.explanation: Both use aviation’s rapid growth and technical or institutional progress as the factual basis for governmental action.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the Committee coordinate them with representatives of the aviation industry and other interested groups
shared_material.parent_excerpt: you will want, of course, to keep in close touch with other groups concerned about this problem, including the Committees of Congress, local authorities and the aviation industry
shared_material.explanation: This is a concrete parallel instruction to consult the aviation industry and other affected outside groups while performing the assigned task.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the wartime potential of aviation is great, but the power of aviation for peace is infinitely greater
shared_material.parent_excerpt: recognition must be given both to the requirements of national defense and to the importance of a progressive and efficient aviation industry in our national economy
shared_material.explanation: Both frame aviation policy through a deliberate balance between defense or military value and broader civilian or peacetime benefits.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I direct the Air Coordinating Committee to develop and coordinate plans
shared_material.parent_excerpt: That is what I want your Commission to do. In undertaking this survey, several major considerations should be kept in mind.
shared_material.explanation: Both letters use a presidential letter to give an aviation body a defined planning assignment followed by considerations and coordination instructions.
